expert_pairs.title: Core + satellite (most common expert split)
expert_pairs.why: One flexi core (PPFAS: India + global, low turnover) plus one small-cap satellite for long-term alpha. Different cap buckets; overlap usually low.

expert_pairs.title: Stable + growth (lower sleep loss)
expert_pairs.why: Large-cap anchor (ICICI Bluechip) + mid-cap engine (HDFC Mid). Classic 60/40 for 15 years: smoother than two aggressive funds.

expert_pairs.title: Transformation + ballast
expert_pairs.why: Kotak Multicap (flexible across caps) + SBI Large Cap (quality large names, some energy). Fits AI/EV/online theme without betting everything on small caps.

expert_pairs.title: Multi-cap + flexi (low overlap)
expert_pairs.why: ICICI Flexicap (EV-heavy book) + Mirae Large & Mid (digital/industrial). Different categories and managers; overlap typically under 25%.

expert_pairs.title: Two cores, different styles
expert_pairs.why: PPFAS (quality + foreign) and HDFC Flexi (India banks/industrials). Experts use this when you want two flexi names that behave differently — but check overlap (~32% historically).

large_cap.label: Large cap
large_cap.sebi: Top 100 stocks by market cap (Nifty 100-ish universe).
large_cap.risk: Lowest volatility in equity; drawdowns ~35–40% in crashes.
large_cap.role: Anchor / core — use when you want smoother 15-year ride.

mid_cap.label: Mid cap
mid_cap.risk: Higher vol than large; can lag for years then catch up.
mid_cap.role: Growth engine — 20–40% of a long portfolio, not 100%.

small_cap.label: Small cap
small_cap.risk: Highest vol; 45–50% drawdowns are normal. Liquidity risk in stress.
small_cap.role: Satellite only — 10–25% for 15+ year horizon if you can hold through pain.

flexi_cap.label: Flexi cap
flexi_cap.sebi: Fund manager chooses across large, mid, and small with no fixed band.
flexi_cap.risk: Depends on how the manager runs it — many flexi funds are large-heavy.
flexi_cap.role: One-stop core — good as primary fund if overlap with second fund is low.

multi_cap.label: Multi cap
multi_cap.sebi: Must invest at least 25% each in large, mid, and small (SEBI rule).
multi_cap.risk: Balanced by mandate; still equity risk.
multi_cap.role: Structured all-cap exposure — alternative to flexi + mid/small pair.

large_mid_cap.label: Large & mid cap
large_mid_cap.sebi: Large + mid only; no small-cap mandate.
large_mid_cap.risk: Between large and mid; less wild than pure mid/small.
large_mid_cap.role: Middle ground core when you do not want small-cap satellite.
